name: sages_row_denizen_blue_creature_enters_target_opponent_mills_two
notes: Printed: 'Whenever another blue creature you control enters, target player mills two cards.' A blue creature enters under seat 0 and seat 0 targets seat 1: seat 1 mills exactly its top two cards (Library 5 then Library 4) and keeps the other four in order. Seat 0's graveyard and library are untouched.
